autonomous_decomposition_events.diagnosis: The upstream module applies the beta contract: it uses supplied gains and offsets or fits four independent affine calibrations from inlier rosette rows, then replaces inlier sweep readings with their references on a deep copy. Both downstream solvers consume the calibrated observations directly and preserve their original inversion and KKT certificate logic. D0 retains Robin leakage; D1 retains reflecting walls. Output parity with the monoliths is not guaranteed when their full-matrix calibration produces a different observation vector from the required diagonal calibration; D1 also included single-bank sweeps in its original fit. Campaign fixtures were not available to verify parity.
